title: Haye Veeran, Zainab Chore Chali
body:
Kol Jay Hondi Thay Ro Ro Kad Di, Mei Teri Laash Chon Teeran Noun
<<DIVIDER>>
Veer Vee Mere Aathara, Khari Mohotaaj Rida Thoun
Kadi Pathar Naee O Vajday Waikhay, Pardaydaar Aseeran Noun
<<DIVIDER>>
Ajey Baqir Vee Ey Qamsin, Mei Vee Paband-e-Rasan Haan
Tera Sajjad Hey Lachaar Veeran, Kiwain Sambhay Ga Zanjeeran Noun
<<DIVIDER>>
Varisan Wali Bay Waris, Koi Pardesan’ch Ja Kay
Allah Janey Kiwain Zainab Tur Paee, Bay Kafan Chore Kay Veeran Noun
<<DIVIDER>>
Paak Sajjad Di Kand Thoun, Chola Chaya Jadon Zainab
Rondi Raee Aun Di Ma Thak Thak Kay, Kand Day Surkh Lakeeran Noun
<<DIVIDER>>
Naal Syedan Day Jo Akhthar, Keethi Jug Nay O Dasa Day
Lokan Bazaaran’ch Pathar Maray, Do Jahanan Day Ameeran Noun
